strings.settings.history_settings.summary: A private record, on this phone only, of the posts, Reels, Stories and profiles you saw.
strings.settings.history_settings.title: History
strings.settings.history_storage_settings.introd: Everything stays in MyInsta's private folder on this phone, left out of Android backups and MyInsta settings backups. Each delete asks first.
strings.settings.history_storage_settings.size: {size}. Clear previews, one type or everything.
strings.settings.history_storage_settings.summar: Clear previews, one type or everything.
strings.settings.history_storage_settings.title: Storage and cleanup
strings.settings.history_storage_used.summary: Records and small previews of this account on this phone.
strings.settings.history_storage_used.title: Space used
strings.settings.history_stories.summary: Each Story that stays open, also the ones Ghost keeps unseen. Ads and Lives are skipped.
strings.settings.history_stories.title: Stories
strings.settings.home.analyzer: Followers, following and changes on your account
strings.settings.home.history: Posts, Reels, Stories and profiles you saw
strings.settings.insights.no_account: Open Instagram with your account first, then try again.
strings.settings.security_analyzer.summary: Ask before opening Analyzer. Set on the Analyzer page.
strings.settings.security_analyzer.title: Protect Analyzer
strings.settings.security_history.summary: Ask before opening History. Set on the History page.
strings.settings.security_history.title: Protect History
strings.settings.history_preview_space.value_hel: {value}. Above it, the oldest previews go and the records stay.
strings.settings.history_storage_keep_limit.summ: The same limit as Keep up to on the History page. The oldest items go first.
strings.settings.history_storage_retention.summa: The same setting as Delete after on the History page. Older items are deleted.
strings.settings.history_storage_retention.title: Delete after
strings.analyzer.dashboard.quick_needs_full: Quick checks need a full update first
strings.settings.analyzer_quick_check.needs_full: Needs a full update first. Then it reads the top of your Followers to find new ones, up to 3 a day.
strings.reels.quality.data_saver: Data saver is on for this network: videos play at up to 480p.
strings.reels.quality.saved: Playback quality: {quality}. The next video you open uses it.
strings.reels.quality.summary: Higher qualities may use more data and buffer more. Download quality is selected separately.
strings.reels.quality.title: Playback quality
strings.settings.reels_quality_hold.summary: Touch and hold the Reels button in the navbar or Home toolbar to choose the video playback quality. Off: Instagram keeps its own action for that hold.
strings.settings.reels_quality_hold.title: Hold Reels for quality
strings.settings.story_organizer_muted.summary: Choose where accounts whose Stories you muted appear.
strings.settings.story_organizer_muted.title: Muted accounts
strings.story.organizer.muted.explanation: Muted accounts are the ones whose Stories you muted on Instagram. Instagram shows them greyed out at the end of the Story bar.
strings.story.organizer.muted.hide.description: Remove them from the Story bar. You can still open their Stories from their profile.
strings.story.organizer.muted.hide.title: Hide these accounts
strings.story.organizer.muted.last.description: Show them after every other account, even after viewed accounts, including when they have new Stories.
strings.story.organizer.muted.last.title: Move to the very end
strings.story.organizer.muted.mix.description: Give these accounts no special place. Accounts with new Stories can come before viewed accounts.
strings.story.organizer.muted.mix.title: Sort like other accounts
strings.story.organizer.muted.note: Uses Instagram's own mute. Muting or unmuting someone is still done in Instagram.
strings.story.organizer.summary.muted_last: Muted accounts at the very end.
strings.settings.hide_interest_prompt.summary: Remove the Are you interested in this post? bubble under suggested posts on Home. Nothing is answered for you.
strings.settings.hide_interest_prompt.title: Hide the Interested question
strings.settings.confirm_follow.summary: Ask before following an account or sending a follow request, so a stray tap does nothing.
strings.settings.confirm_follow.title: Confirm before following
strings.settings.confirm_unfollow.summary: Ask before unfollowing or cancelling a follow request, unless Instagram already asks.
strings.settings.confirm_unfollow.title: Confirm before unfollowing
strings.fonts.swap.empty: Open the Story text editor once and Instagram's fonts appear here.
strings.fonts.swap.notice: Each Instagram font keeps its name and its background styles; only the letters change. Your Story is posted as a normal Instagram font. Import a font, then pick one for each font here.
strings.fonts.swap.saved: Story font updated. Reopen the Story editor to see it.
strings.fonts.swap.sheet_message: Draw this Instagram font with one from your library. Background styles stay the same.
strings.fonts.swap.title: Replace Instagram fonts
strings.fonts.ios.title: iOS Story styles
strings.fonts.ios.toggle_description: Draws Typewriter, Strong, Meme, Elegant, Directional and Literature like Instagram for iOS. Each keeps its backgrounds.
strings.fonts.ios.notice: Instagram for iOS draws these styles with Apple fonts, which can't be shared. MyInsta uses free fonts that look alike (SIL Open Font License 1.1): Courier Prime, Mulish, Comic Neue, Playfair Display, Barlow and EB Garamond. A font you pick below for a style is used instead. Reopen the Story editor to see the change.
strings.fonts.ios.enabled: iOS Story styles on. Reopen the Story editor to see them.
strings.fonts.ios.disabled: iOS Story styles off. Instagram's fonts are back.
strings.reel_origin.not_found: Couldn't find the reel you came from
strings.reel_origin.not_on_profile: That reel isn't on their profile. It may be a trial reel.
strings.settings.find_reel_origin.summary: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab: it scrolls to that reel and outlines it. It looks a few pages down at most, and Stop looking ends it sooner. Needs the Reels tab on profiles.
strings.settings.find_reel_origin.title: Find the reel you came from
strings.settings.find_reel_origin_wait.summary: Only look further down after you tap Find the reel. A reel already on screen is still outlined.
strings.settings.find_reel_origin_wait.title: Wait for a tap
strings.settings.ota_auto_install.summary: Download and check new releases in the background on Wi-Fi, then ask Android to install them. Android may still ask you to confirm. A protected beta needs its password first.
strings.settings.ota_auto_install.title: Automatic updates
strings.settings.unsent_own.summary: Also keep messages you unsend, on this phone or another device, with their photos, videos and view-once media when those are on. They stay only here, with no notifications.
strings.settings.unsent_own.title: Your own messages
